psychological_meaning: Shadow represents mystery, the unknown, and introspection. It can evoke feelings of fear or uncertainty, but also a sense of depth and hidden potential. Shadow colors are often associated with sophistication and elegance, adding a touch of drama and intrigue to designs. They can also signify protection and security.
